2607.09798.title: JEPA for AI-Native 6G: Predictive Representations and Open Challenges
2607.09798.paper_summary: Sixth-generation (6G) networks are moving toward AI-native operation, where learning modules are embedded across the radio access network (RAN), edge, and core. This transition requires learning from limited labels, heterogeneous wireless and network data, partial observations, non-stationary propagation, and latency-constrained control loops. Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) is a promising self-supervised paradigm for this setting because it predicts missing or future representations in latent space instead of reconstructing raw measurements or using contrastive negative samples. This article presents a wireless-oriented tutorial on JEPA for 6G intelligence. We define the JEPA training mechanism, describe how CSI, beam measurements, KPIs, topology graphs, and sensing observations can be tokenized and masked, and position the learned encoder as a predictive representation layer for RAN, O-RAN, edge, and core functions, with task-specific heads or controllers producing final decisions. Then we present an illustrative, beam-management case study suggesting that a wireless-aware target, specifically an auxiliary future beam-energy target during self-supervised pretraining, can improve label efficiency and robustness across shifted deployment conditions relative to a supervised source domain. Finally, we outline open challenges in multi-timescale prediction, action-conditioned modeling, distributed training, trustworthiness, efficient deployment, benchmarking, and standardization.
2607.09798.paper_summary_zh: 第六代（6G）網絡正朝著人工智慧原生操作的方向發展，其中學習模塊嵌入於無線接入網絡（RAN）、邊緣和核心中。這一過渡需要從有限的標籤、異質的無線和網絡數據、部分觀察、非穩態傳播以及延遲受限的控制迴路中學習。聯合嵌入預測架構（JEPA）是一種有前景的自我監督範式，因為它在潛在空間中預測缺失或未來的表示，而不是重建原始測量或使用對比負樣本。本文提供了一個針對6G智能的無線導向JEPA教程。我們定義了JEPA訓練機制，描述了如何將CSI、波束測量、KPI、拓撲圖和感測觀察進行標記和遮蔽，並將學習到的編碼器定位為RAN、O-RAN、邊緣和核心功能的預測表示層，並由特定任務的頭部或控制器產生最終決策。然後，我們呈現了一個說明性的波束管理案例研究，建議一個無線感知目標，特別是在自我監督預訓練期間的輔助未來波束能量目標，可以提高標籤效率和在相對於監督源域的變化部署條件下的穩健性。最後，我們概述了在多時間尺度預測、行動條件建模、分佈式訓練、可信度、高效部署、基準測試和標準化方面的開放挑戰。
